amountMinVnd.note: Product-page FAQ: 'Thông thường, ngân hàng có các khoản vay tối thiểu từ 20 triệu đồng. Tuy nhiên, số tiền vay có thể thay đổi tùy theo từng thời điểm'. 'Thông thường' makes this typical, not a hard rule, so medium. VPBank blogs say 30 triệu or 10 triệu (conflicts). The vayonline page states no minimum.

amountMaxVnd.note: vayonline: 'Lên đến 200 triệu'. The official product page says 500 triệu in its headline and 750 triệu / 15 times income in its FAQ, so the official pages disagree. We store the lowest (200 triệu). The vayonline form is shared by several VPBank loan pages (see notes), and its 200 triệu also matches the existing-customer loan page.

minPercent.note: Official product page: 'Lãi suất từ 18%/năm theo dư nợ giảm dần' (a 'từ' floor, which fits as the low end). vayonline says 'tối thiểu từ 1,2%/tháng tương đương 14.4%/năm'. Both are VPBank pages, so we store the higher (18) and record 14.4 in conflicts. VPBank blogs also say 'từ 18%/năm' and '18-35%/năm'. This is the lowest possible rate, not the user's rate.

maxPercent.note: vayonline FAQ and footnote: 'tối đa 59%/năm tùy từng khoản vay và theo thời gian dư nợ giảm dần'. This is the only official place that states a maximum. The product page, the existing-customer page and the 2026-11-02 rate notice state none; VPBank blogs say 35%/năm (conflicts). Treat 59% as VPBank's own stated top on the shared vayonline form, not confirmed on this product's page. Not checked against any legal cap.

Reference rate for a 2-month loan: 10.4%/năm. For a 12-month loan: 11.6%; over 24 to 60 months: 12.2%. Loans disbursed before 16/10/2023 use a table 0.2 point lower (10.2% to 12.0%). The notice says it applies to adjustable-rate loans; the customer's rate adds a margin set by VPBank that the notice does not give. The listing page shows effective 00:00 30/10/2026 while the document title says from 02/11/2026.

Another VPBank domain (uudaicanhan.vpbank.com.vn) could not be opened; a search-engine summary of it mentions 1% under 12 months and tiers down to free. Not verified.

insurance.nameVi: Bảo hiểm khoản vay (tử vong, thương tật toàn bộ vĩnh viễn)

mandatory.note: Not stated for this loan. vayonline lists it under 'Các loại phí có thể phát sinh' (fees that may arise) and the example includes it. The general credit terms of 07/11/2022 say the customer must buy loan insurance 'if VPBank requires' it, and the one-off loan terms make completing the insurance purchase a disbursement condition, but no loan document says VPBank requires it for this loan. No VPBank page says it is optional. Left unknown, not assumed.

collection.note: vayonline FAQ: VPBank sums the premium over the whole term and collects it all at disbursement ('thu toàn bộ số tiền này tại thời điểm giải ngân'). It does not say if the amount is deducted from the payout or added to the loan; the two change the cost. The published example's payment is about 96,000 VND/month above a plain 20% annuity, which would fit a financed premium, but that example does not add up (see representativeExamples), so we do not infer it.

method.note: vayonline FAQ: premium 1,3 - 1,8%/năm on declining balance ('tính trên dư nợ giảm dần'), summed over the whole term and collected at disbursement. By that formula the example (100M, 12 months, 1.6%) comes to roughly 0.76 to 0.89 million VND depending on whether month-end or month-start balances are used (our arithmetic, not a VPBank figure).

ratePercentMin.note: vayonline: 'từ 1,3%/năm'. A search-engine summary of the unreachable uudaicanhan.vpbank.com.vn page also says 1,3%/năm; not read by us. The page example uses 1,6%.

ratePercentMax.note: vayonline: 'đến 1,8%/năm'. The published example's payment implies about 1,86%/năm if the premium was added to the loan (above this range); see representativeExamples.

insurance.covers: Death or permanent total disability (vayonline FAQ). The insurer pays the outstanding balance to VPBank. The insurer's name is not stated.

textVi.value: Nợ gốc trả chậm bị tính lãi bằng 150% lãi suất trong hạn. Tiền lãi trả chậm bị tính thêm lãi, tối đa 10%/năm. Trả chậm cũng làm xấu lịch sử tín dụng của bạn.
textVi.note: Translated from the vayonline FAQ (re-read 2026-11-03): overdue principal 150% of the in-term rate; late interest 150% of the in-term rate, capped at 10%/year. The general loan terms (clauses 3.3, 3.5; dated November 2018, last digits of the date illegible) say the same.

overduePrincipalRateMultiplier.note: FAQ: 150% of the in-term rate on overdue principal.

overdueInterestRatePercentYear.note: FAQ: late interest 150% of the in-term rate, at most 10%/năm. Stored as the cap.

representativeExamples.note: Page (re-read 2026-11-03): 'khoản vay tiêu dùng VPBank 100.000.000, kỳ hạn vay 12 tháng, lãi suất 20% trên dư nợ giảm dần và 1.6% phí bảo hiểm ... thanh toán hàng tháng là 9,359,500'. Our recomputation (annuity, 100M, 12 months): at 20%/yr the payment is 9,263,451 whether months are 1/12 of a year or actual days/365 (about 30.4 days). 9,359,500 is 96,049 higher a month, 1,152,593 over the term. (a) If the 1.6%/yr premium on declining balance is added to the loan, the payment would be about 9,346,165, which is 13,335 below the published figure. (b) A financed premium that would give exactly 9,359,500 is about 1,036,864 VND (1.04% of the loan, equal to about 1.86%/yr on declining balance), above the stated 1,3-1,8% range, and about 16% more than 1.6% gives. (c) The closest exact match is a plain annuity at 22.0%/yr: 9,359,438, which rounds up to 9,359,500 at the next 100 VND; no stated input gives 22%. Adding 1.6 points to the rate (21.6%) gives 9,340,198, not a match. So the page does not reconcile with its own inputs, and it doesn't say how the payment was computed. The rate period (20% per year) is not written in the sentence; only a yearly reading gives a payment of this size, but we leave it unknown. Total repaid is not published. Do not use as a test fixture. Source document date unknown (footer 2022).

products.notes: The vayonline page is a lead-capture form shared by several VPBank loan pages: the 'Đăng ký' buttons of this loan (utm_content=vaytieudung), the existing-customer loan (utm_content=ETB) and the salary-account overdraft (utm_content=pdpayroll) all open it. Its banners (200 triệu, no income proof, từ 1,2%/tháng) match the existing-customer page better than this one, so its range may not describe this product alone. The official product page (tin-chap-ca-nhan) is now the main source: it states equal monthly payments with interest on declining balance, 12-60 months, from 18%/năm, 22-65 years, income from 5 triệu. The vayonline page footer shows 2022 and neither page shows an 'updated' date; VPBank staff set the real offer, so ranges are indicative. Kept in ranking because VPBank itself states a minimum and a maximum yearly rate on a reducing balance (18 and 59). The worked example does not add up (internallyConsistent=false), 59% is stated on one page only, and the minimum rate differs between two VPBank pages. If a stricter rule is wanted, exclude it until VPBank states the maximum on the product page or in a rate notice.

products.notes: Searched, not published: the interest rate. Looked at the product page (all tabs, including the FAQ), the two linked terms PDFs, VPBank's overdraft-account fee schedule, the 15/01/2026 individual fee schedule (no overdraft or loan lines), the 02/11/2026 reference-rate notice (a base for adjustable-rate loans, not this product's rate), the vayonline form, the NEO app listing and the loan calculator (it only takes a user-typed rate). From the 2018 overdraft terms: interest is on the actual balance for actual days over 365; the in-term rate is fixed for the term unless the limit is exceeded; interest is paid monthly (statement on the 5th, pay within 10 days); principal can be paid in part or at the end; the borrower cannot withdraw cash from the overdraft (clause 3.2). A different product, 'Thấu chi ứng lương' on VPBank NEO, has published rates (20-29%/năm by income); it is recorded separately. Fees on file are from a 2016 schedule.

researchNotes: 2026-11-03 deep dive. 1) Licence: vpbank is on data/licensed-institutions.json. 2) The vayonline page is a shared lead form, not one product: the 'Đăng ký' buttons of the salary-based loan, the existing-customer loan and the salary-account overdraft all open it (utm_content vaytieudung, ETB, pdpayroll). Its 200 triệu / no income proof / từ 1,2%/tháng banners fit the existing-customer page, whose own figure is 'từ 16%/năm'. 3) Example 100M/12 months/20%/1.6% = 9,359,500 does not reconcile: plain 20% annuity 9,263,451; with the stated 1.6% premium on declining balance financed about 9,346,165; the published payment equals a plain annuity at 22.0%/yr (9,359,438) or a financed premium of about 1.04M VND (1.86%/yr, above the stated 1.3-1.8%). Cause unknown. 4) Insurance: 1,3-1,8%/năm on declining balance, summed over the term and collected in full at disbursement (vayonline FAQ). Mandatory or optional is not stated anywhere we could read; the general credit terms (07/11/2022) make buying cover an obligation only when VPBank requires it, and disbursement conditions mention completing the purchase of insurance. Deducted-vs-financed not stated. 5) 59%/năm appears only on vayonline; the product page gives 'từ 18%/năm' and no maximum; blogs say 18-35%. The 02/11/2026 reference-rate notice (10.4-12.2%/năm) is a benchmark for adjustable-rate loans, without the margin. 6) '16%/year' from a secondary site: supported by the official existing-customer page (advertised floor, existing customers only), not by any general or offered-range source. 7) Early repayment: vayonline 4%/3% of prepaid amount (min 1.000.000/600.000); a VPBank blog says 4%/2%/1% of remaining principal by year; the general terms say the fee is whatever the customer's own contract states; uudaicanhan.vpbank.com.vn (tiers 1%.. free) could not be opened (DNS failure from our side), nor vpbankonline.vpbank.com.vn (DNS) and vaytinchap.vpbank.com.vn (connection refused). 8) Searched, not published: a consumer unsecured-loan biểu phí (none among the 17 individual-customer fee documents listed on vpbank.com.vn/tai-lieu-bieu-mau; they cover accounts, cards, transfers, overdraft accounts and base rates), any application or disbursement fee, the overdraft interest rate, the insurer's name. The 15/01/2026 individual fee schedule has no loan or overdraft lines, only a note that insurance-collection accounts of insurers partnering in VPBank's credit-insurance programme pay no cash-deposit or transfer fee. 9) Not added: VPBank-staff loans; loans for holders of a secured loan; CAKE by VPBank partner loans (rate table of 01/03/2023 gives 8%, 35-60% and 31-36% for VNPT Money/Viettel Money flows, too old and partner-specific; recent news mentions a cash loan up to 50 triệu through the Thế Giới Di Động app and 1,67%/tháng for Be drivers; none read from an official page); credit-card installments (unchanged, not verified at source). 10) The NEO app listing on Google Play states no rate; it says approval 'sau 1 phút đăng kí online, không cần chứng minh tài chính'. Not usable for figures.
